title: 第一卷 第19章 洞房第一卷 第20章 他到底藏了多少秘密
slug: 斗罗v开局上交系统全宗为我抢亲
lines: 深坑里，玉元震挣扎着坐起身。
他那身原本华贵的长袍自然成了破布条。
焦黑的痕迹和星星点点的血迹交织在一起，看起来狠是狼狈。
听到宁天居然开口要万年魂骨，玉元震气得喉咙一甜。
“宁风致……”
玉元震声音嘶哑。
宁风致此时终于从主位上站了起来。
他一挥袖口，姿态从容地走下台阶，脸上挂着招牌式的儒雅笑容。
刚才那场差点毁掉半个宗门的战斗，普通根本没发生过一般。
“天儿，不得无礼。”
宁风致先是轻飘飘地呵斥了宁天一句，随后看向坑里的玉元震。
“老宗主，天儿年纪小，说话直了点，您别往心里去。”
“不过，他有一句话说得对，今日确实是我宗大喜之日。”
“您这带着几十号人冲阵，若是不给天下同道一个交代，我七宝琉璃宗的脸面，往哪儿搁？”
宁风致的话听起来客气，可语气里的强硬几乎没有掩饰。
尘心此时也从空中缓缓落下，背后的七杀剑虚影微微一震。
玉元震眼皮狂跳。
他看明白了。
宁天是在前面唱白脸敲竹杠，宁风致是在后面唱红脸递刀子。
如果不掏点东西出来，今天这门怕是出不去了。
玉元震深吸一口气，从怀里摸出一个盒子，咬牙切齿地甩向高台。
“这是一块五千年的雷鸣草，价值足以媲美一般的万年灵药，算是我蓝电霸王龙宗给宁少主的贺礼！”
宁天眼疾手快，一把接住盒子，直接当众打开。
“才五千年啊？”
宁天撇了撇嘴，一脸嫌弃。
“老宗主，你这诚意有点缩水啊？”
玉元震气得浑身发抖，指着宁天，“你……”
“天儿，收下吧。”
宁风致适时开口，打断了这对父子的双簧。
他对着玉元震拱了拱手，
“既然贺礼送到了，老宗主身上有伤，就不留您喝喜酒了。
改日宁某定登门致谢。”
这是在下逐客令了。
玉元震闻言，点了点头，随后也不多说，带着人就离开了。
“这……这就完事了？”
萨拉斯主教坐在席位上，看着远去的雷光，手里的筷子都掉了一根。
原本以为是龙争虎斗，结果竟然是单方面碾压。
不久后。
“吉时已到！
送新人入洞房——！”
content_en:
In the pit, Yu Yuanzhen struggled to sit up.
His originally luxurious robes naturally turned into rags.
The scorched black marks and scattered blood stains were intertwined, making it look extremely embarrassing.
Hearing that Ning Tian actually asked for the ten-thousand-year soul bone, Yu Yuanzhen felt so angry that his throat became sweet.
"Ning Fengzhi..."
Yu Yuanzhen's voice was hoarse.
Ning Fengzhi finally stood up from his seat.
He waved his sleeves and walked down the steps calmly, with his signature elegant smile on his face.
The battle that almost destroyed half of the sect just now seemed like it never happened.
"Tian'er, don't be rude."
Ning Fengzhi first lightly scolded Ning Tian, and then looked at Yu Yuanzhen in the pit.
"Old sect leader, Tian'er is young and speaks more frankly. Don't take it to heart."
"However, what he said is right. Today is indeed a happy day for our sect."
"You are charging into the battle with dozens of people. If you don't give an explanation to the comrades in the world, where will the face of our Qibao Glazed Sect be put?"
Ning Fengzhi's words sounded polite, but the toughness in his tone was barely concealed.
Chen Xin also slowly fell from the air at this time, and the shadow of the Seven Killing Sword behind him shook slightly.
Yu Yuanzhen's eyelids jumped wildly.
He understood.
Ning Tian is playing the bad guy in the front and extorting money, while Ning Fengzhi is playing the red face in the back and handing out the knife.
If I don't take out something, I'm afraid I won't be able to get out of this door today.
Yu Yuanzhen took a deep breath, took out a box from his arms, gritted his teeth and threw it towards the high platform.
"This is a five-thousand-year-old piece of thunder grass. Its value is comparable to the ordinary ten-thousand-year elixir. It can be regarded as a congratulatory gift to Young Master Ning from our Blue Lightning Tyrant Dragon Sect!"
Ning Tian, with quick eyes and quick hands, caught the box and opened it in front of everyone.
"Only five thousand years?"
Ning Tian curled his lips with a look of disgust.
"Old sect master, your sincerity has shrunk a bit, haven't you?"
Yu Yuanzhen was so angry that he was shaking all over, pointing at Ning Tian, "You..."
"Tian'er, take it."
Ning Fengzhi spoke at the right moment, interrupting the double act between father and son.
He raised his hands to Yu Yuanzhen,
“Since the congratulatory gifts have been delivered, the old sect master is injured, so I won’t let you have the wedding banquet.
Ning will come to express his gratitude the next day. "
This is an eviction order.
Hearing this, Yu Yuanzhen nodded, and then left without saying much.
"This...is it over?"
Bishop Salas was sitting on his seat, looking at the distant lightning, and even one of the chopsticks in his hand dropped.
Originally thought it was a fight between dragons and tigers, but it turned out to be a unilateral crushing.
…
Soon after.
“The auspicious time has come!
Sending the newlyweds into the bridal chamber—! "
